Ordinary Council Meeting - 27 August 2025

Wednesday, August 27, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Chambers

The Town of Port Hedland Council no longer has a quorum. The Department of Local Government, Industry Regulation and Safety has declined a request for the Council to operate with a reduction of quorum. You can read the letter from the Department here.

The Minister for Local Government Hannah Beazley has confirmed three commissioners have been appointed to oversee the Town of Port Hedland until March 2026. You can read Minister Beazley's statement here. (2/09/2025)

The Town of Port Hedland has published an update regarding the appointment of commissioners and other related information. Read news story here. (2/09/2025)

The Town of Port Hedland would like to acknowledge the Kariyarra, Ngarla, and Nyamal people as the Traditional Custodians of the Town of Port Hedland lands. We recognise their strength and resilience and pay our respects to their Elders past and present.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 7 May 2025

Wednesday, May 7, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Chambers- Civic Centre- Mcgregor Street

The Ordinary Council Meeting for 30 April 2025 was adjourned after failure to meet quorum. 

The following Agenda is for an Ordinary Council Meeting to be held on Wednesday, 7 May 2025 at 5:30pm to decide items from the 30 April 2025 Agenda.

The Town of Port Hedland would like to acknowledge the Kariyarra, Ngarla, and Nyamal people as the Traditional Custodians of the Town of Port Hedland lands. We recognise their strength and resilience and pay our respects to their Elders past and present.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 5 February 2025

Wednesday, February 5, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Chambers

Agenda

Public Agenda for the Ordinary Council Meeting to be held on 5 February 2025 (708.31 KB)

The Town of Port Hedland would like to acknowledge the Kariyarra, Ngarla, and Nyamal people as the Traditional Custodians of the Town of Port Hedland lands. We recognise their strength and resilience and pay our respects to their Elders past and present.

Special Council Meeting - 16 October 2025

Thursday, October 16, 2025 - 05:30 PM

The purpose of the Special Meeting is consideration of:

  1. Application for development approval for electricity transmission lines on various state government landholdings.
  2. Application for development approval for Port Hedland power station expansion on Lot 255 (No. 53) Boodarie Station Access Road, Boodarie.
  3. Application to Amend Development Approval for Temporary Workforce Accommodation on Lot 2 (No. 15) Dempster Street, Port Hedland.
  4. Scheme Amendment No. 6 to Local Planning Scheme No. 7 - Short Term Rental Accommodation - Initiation for Advertising.

Special Council Meeting - 16 October 2025

Thursday, October 16, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Civic Centre - Chambers

Agenda

Agenda for the Special Council Meeting to be held Thursday, 16 October 2025 at 5:30pm (773.11 KB)

Minutes

Confirmed Minutes of the Special Council Meeting held on 16 October 2025 (1.24 MB)

Document

Attachments for the Special Council Meeting to be held Thursday, 16 October 2025 (26.61 MB)

The Town of Port Hedland would like to acknowledge the Kariyarra, Ngarla, and Nyamal people as the Traditional Custodians of the Town of Port Hedland lands. We recognise their strength and resilience and pay our respects to their Elders past and present.

Special Council Meeting - 22 December 2025

Monday, December 22, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Civic Centre - Chambers

Please see link to watch LIVE here-Video Library » Town of Port Hedland 

Please provide questions prior to this meeting here.

Note that public questions must be in regard to items for discussion at this Special Council Meeting.

NOTICE PURSUANT TO SECTION 5.4(a)(i) - SPECIAL MEETING OF COUNCIL

The purpose of the Special Meeting is to consider the following items:

  • Award of Tender RFT202526-10 JD Hardie Youth & Community Hub Masterplan - Stage 3
  • Adoption of the 9 December 2025 Special ARC Meeting Minutes including the adoption of the FY2025 Audited Financial Statements, Independent Auditor's Closing Report and Management Letter of Audit Findings
  • Adoption of the FY25 Annual Report
  • Appointment of Presiding and Deputy Presiding Members of the CEO Recruitment Committee
  • Confidential Item: Key Worker Housing Proposal

The Town of Port Hedland would like to acknowledge the Kariyarra, Ngarla, and Nyamal people as the Traditional Custodians of the Town of Port Hedland lands. We recognise their strength and resilience and pay our respects to their Elders past and present.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 28 April 2021

Wednesday, April 28, 2021 - 05:30 PM

Ordinary Council Meetings are held on a monthly basis at the Civic Centre. All residents are welcome to attend, however, if you cannot make it in person, proceedings are streamed live. If you miss the live broadcast, you can review the recording at a later time.

Those persons wishing to ask questions verbally at this meeting  should submit the questions to council@porthedland.wa.gov.au or by hand to the Civic Centre one week in advance.  A maximum of three questions are permitted.  Answers  to questions received within that timeframe will, where practicable, be provided at the meeting.

Those persons wishing to ask questions verbally at this meeting  should submit the questions to council@porthedland.wa.gov.au or by hand to the Civic Centre one week in advance.  A maximum of three questions are permitted.  Answers  to questions received within that timeframe will, where practicable, be provided at the meeting.

Ordinary Council Meeting - 26 February 2020

Wednesday, February 26, 2020 - 05:30 PM

Those persons wishing to ask questions verbally at this meeting  should submit the questions to council@porthedland.wa.gov.au or by hand to the Civic Centre one week in advance.  A maximum of three questions are permitted.  Answers  to questions received within that timeframe will, where practicable, be provided at the meeting.

Monday, October 19, 2020 - 04:20 PM

Agenda

Agenda for the Special Council Meeting on 19 October 2020 (533.37 KB)

Minutes

Confirmed Minutes for the Special Council Meeting on 19 October 2020 (501.78 KB)

The Town of Port Hedland would like to acknowledge the Kariyarra, Ngarla, and Nyamal people as the Traditional Custodians of the Town of Port Hedland lands. We recognise their strength and resilience and pay our respects to their Elders past and present.
